titleEn: Kitchen Renovation Costs in BC: 2026 Guide by Reno Stars
titleZh: BC省厨房装修费用指南：聚星装修2026版
contentEn:
Reno Stars has completed over 200 kitchen renovations across Metro Vancouver since 2015. This guide covers real material and labour costs for kitchen renovation projects in British Columbia in 2026, drawn from our actual project data and publicly available construction cost indices.

What Does a Kitchen Renovation Cost in BC in 2026?

The average mid-range kitchen renovation in Metro Vancouver costs between $35,000 and $85,000 in 2026, according to Reno Stars' completed project records. A luxury custom kitchen with high-end appliances, stone countertops, and custom cabinetry can exceed $150,000. Budget renovations that replace cabinets, countertops, and flooring without altering the layout typically start at $18,000.

These prices reflect current material costs including cabinetry, countertops, plumbing fixtures, electrical upgrades, and labour. They do not include structural changes, moving gas or plumbing rough-ins, or permits where required.

Cost Breakdown by Kitchen Component

The single largest expense in any kitchen renovation is cabinetry, typically consuming 30–40% of the total budget. Here is how the major cost categories typically divide:

  • Custom or semi-custom cabinetry: $12,000–$45,000 depending on layout size and material
  • Countertops (quartz, granite, or solid surface): $3,500–$12,000
  • Appliances (fridge, stove, dishwasher, range hood): $4,000–$15,000
  • Electrical upgrades (outlets, lighting, panel upgrades): $2,000–$7,500
  • Plumbing fixtures and rough-in adjustments: $1,500–$5,000
  • Flooring (hardwood, tile, or luxury vinyl): $2,500–$8,000
  • Labour and installation: $8,000–$25,000 depending on scope
  • Permits and inspections (where applicable): $500–$2,500

Kitchen Renovation Costs by City in Metro Vancouver

Labour and material costs vary across municipalities due to permit fees, disposal costs, and local demand. Based on Reno Stars' project records:

  • Vancouver: $40,000–$95,000 average. Higher labour costs and permit fees reflect city-specific requirements. Heritage retention grants may apply for designated homes.
  • Richmond: $35,000–$85,000 average. Strong demand from new homeowners drives consistent renovation activity. Newer builds often have more standard layouts that reduce structural change costs.
  • Burnaby: $33,000–$80,000 average. Mix of post-war homes requiring updates and newer developments. Disposal and permit fees are moderate.
  • North Vancouver / West Vancouver: $45,000–$110,000 average. Larger project footprints and higher material specifications. Custom builds and high-end finishes are more common.
  • Coquitlam / Port Coquitlam: $30,000–$75,000 average. More new construction homes with standard layouts reduce change-order costs. Permit fees are competitive.
  • Delta / Surrey: $28,000–$70,000 average. Lower land and labour costs compared to Vancouver proper. Active new-home communities generate steady renovation demand.

What Affects Kitchen Renovation Cost?

Layout changes are the single biggest cost variable. Moving a sink, stove, or island requires rerouting drain lines, supply pipes, and often electrical circuits. Each major move adds $3,000–$8,000 to a project. Keeping the existing layout and simply replacing surfaces is the most cost-effective approach.

Cabinetry material choice drives the second-largest variance. Thermofoil or laminate cabinets start around $150–$300 per linear foot. Solid wood or MDF cabinets with painted finishes range from $300–$600 per linear foot. Full custom hardwood cabinetry starts from $600 per linear foot and can reach $1,200+ for exotic species or intricate detailing.

Countertop material similarly affects budget significantly. Laminate countertops start under $30 per square foot installed. Quartz and granite typically run $55–$120 per square foot installed. Marble or high-end porcelain slabs can exceed $150 per square foot.

How Long Does a Kitchen Renovation Take?

A typical mid-range kitchen renovation in Metro Vancouver takes 8–14 weeks from demolition to final inspection. Luxury or layout-change projects can extend to 16–24 weeks. Reno Stars' average bathroom renovation timeline is documented in our dedicated guide. Kitchen timelines are generally 30–50% longer due to the greater number of trade disciplines involved — carpentry, electrical, plumbing, and tiling typically overlap.

Key timeline factors include whether the layout stays the same, the complexity of cabinetry (custom builds require 4–8 weeks of lead time), and permit requirements in the specific municipality.

How to Budget for Your Kitchen Renovation

Reno Stars recommends the following budgeting framework based on our project experience:

  • Allocate 10–15% of the total budget as a contingency fund for unforeseen conditions, particularly in post-war homes where hidden framing or outdated wiring is common.
  • Prioritise cabinetry quality — cabinets are the visual centrepiece of the kitchen and the hardest element to change after installation.
  • Consider staggered upgrades: complete the layout, cabinetry, and countertops in one project; upgrade appliances separately as they wear out.
  • Factor in living costs during the renovation: many homeowners choose to relocate to temporary housing for 3–6 weeks during a major kitchen project.

Financing Options in British Columbia

Several financing options are available for BC homeowners. Canadian mortgage refinance programs allow borrowing up to 80% of home equity for major renovations. Metro Vancouver renovation loans through chartered banks typically range from $10,000 to $150,000 with terms of 3–10 years. Home equity lines of credit (HELOCs) offer flexible draw-down arrangements for projects that unfold over several months.

BC Home Improvement Act loans are also available through designated lenders for energy-efficient upgrades, though not all kitchen renovations qualify unless they meet specific efficiency thresholds.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average cost of a kitchen renovation in Vancouver in 2026?

The average mid-range kitchen renovation in Vancouver costs between $40,000 and $95,000 in 2026. Budget projects starting around $18,000 are possible for cosmetic-only upgrades. Luxury custom kitchens with high-end finishes routinely exceed $150,000. Costs vary by scope, layout complexity, and material specifications.

How much does cabinetry cost for a kitchen in BC?

Cabinetry in BC ranges from $150 per linear foot for thermofoil laminate to $600+ per linear foot for custom solid-wood units. A typical 30-linear-foot kitchen (standard galley or L-shaped layout) therefore ranges from $4,500 to $18,000 for cabinetry alone, before installation, hardware, or interior accessories.

How long does a kitchen renovation take in Metro Vancouver?

A mid-range kitchen renovation in Metro Vancouver typically takes 8–14 weeks from demolition through to final inspection. Layout changes, custom cabinetry lead times, and municipal permit requirements can extend this to 16–24 weeks for larger or more complex projects.

Do I need a permit for a kitchen renovation in BC?

Permits are required in BC when the scope includes moving plumbing fixtures, altering electrical panel capacity, removing or adding walls, or changing the use of a room. Cosmetic replacements of cabinets, flooring, countertops, and fixtures within the existing layout generally do not require a permit, though this varies by municipality. Always confirm with your local building department before starting work.

What is the best countertop material for value in a BC kitchen?

Quartz offers the best combination of durability, low maintenance, and aesthetic range for most BC kitchens. It resists moisture, staining, and chips better than granite in busy households. At $55–$120 per square foot installed, it sits in the mid-to-premium price range and holds its value well at resale.
contentZh:
自2015年以来，聚星装修已在温哥华地区完成了超过200个厨房装修项目。本指南基于我们的实际项目数据，涵盖2026年不列颠哥伦比亚省厨房装修的真实材料与人工成本。

2026年BC省厨房装修费用是多少？

根据聚星装修已完成项目记录，2026年大温哥华地区中档厨房装修平均费用在35,000至85,000加元之间。配备高端电器、石英石台面和定制橱柜的豪华定制厨房可能超过150,000加元。仅更换橱柜、台面和地板而不改变布局的经济型装修通常从18,000加元起。

厨房装修费用明细

橱柜是每个厨房装修中最大的开支，通常占总预算的30%至40%。主要成本分类如下：

  • 定制或半定制橱柜：根据布局大小和材料，$12,000至$45,000
  • 台面（石英石、花岗岩或实心表面）：$3,500至$12,000
  • 电器（冰箱、炉灶、洗碗机、抽油烟机）：$4,000至$15,000
  • 电气升级（插座、照明、配电箱升级）：$2,000至$7,500
  • 管道装置和粗调调整：$1,500至$5,000
  • 地板（硬木、瓷砖或豪华乙烯基）：$2,500至$8,000
  • 人工和安装：根据工程范围，$8,000至$25,000
  • 许可和检查（如适用）：$500至$2,500

大温哥华各城市厨房装修费用

基于聚星装修的项目记录，各城市的劳动力和材料成本存在差异：

  • 温哥华：平均$40,000至$95,000。较高的劳动力成本和许可费用反映了城市特定要求。
  • 列治文：平均$35,000至$85,000。新建住宅需求旺盛，装修活动持续活跃。
  • 本拿比：平均$33,000至$80,000。老旧住宅与新开发项目并存，装修需求稳定。
  • 北温/西温：平均$45,000至$110,000。项目规模较大，材料规格更高。
  • 高贵林/Port Coquitlam：平均$30,000至$75,000。新建住宅比例高，标准布局降低改造成本。
  • 三角洲/萨里：平均$28,000至$70,000。与温哥华相比，劳动力和土地成本较低。

哪些因素影响厨房装修费用？

布局变化是最大的成本变量。移动水槽、炉灶或岛台需要重新铺设排水管、供水管，通常还需要重新布线。每个主要移动项目增加$3,000至$8,000的成本。保持现有布局仅更换表面是最具成本效益的方式。

厨房装修需要多长时间？

大温哥华地区典型的中档厨房装修从拆除到最终检查通常需要8至14周。豪华或涉及布局变化的项目可能延长至16至24周。橱柜的定制度越高，交付周期越长（通常4至8周的备货时间）。

如何为厨房装修做预算？

  • 预留总预算10%至15%作为应急资金，特别是对于战后住宅，隐藏的结构问题或过时布线很常见。
  • 优先考虑橱柜质量——橱柜是厨房的视觉中心，安装后最难更换。
  • 考虑分阶段升级：将布局、橱柜和台面放在一个项目完成；电器等以后单独升级。

  • 全屋装修 — 三角洲
  • 地下室装修 — 温哥华

常见问题

2026年温哥华厨房装修平均费用是多少？

2026年温哥华中档厨房装修平均费用在$40,000至$95,000之间。仅做表面装修的经济型项目可从$18,000起。配备高端定制饰面的豪华定制厨房通常超过$150,000。

BC省厨房橱柜费用是多少？

BC省橱柜价格从每线性英尺$150（热压成型层压板）到每线性英尺$600以上（定制实木）不等。典型30线性英尺的厨房（即标准走廊式或L形布局）的橱柜（仅橱柜本身，不含安装、五金或内部配件）费用在$4,500至$18,000之间。

大温哥华厨房装修需要多长时间？

大温哥华地区中档厨房装修从拆除到最终检查通常需要8至14周。涉及布局变更、定制橱柜备货时间和市政许可要求的大型或复杂项目可能延长至16至24周。

BC省厨房装修需要申请许可吗？

在BC省，当工程范围包括移动管道装置、改变配电箱容量、拆除或添加墙壁，或改变房间用途时，需要申请许可。在现有布局内仅更换橱柜、地板、台面和装置的表面装修通常不需要许可，但具体规定因市政当局而异。

BC省厨房台面最佳性价比材料是什么？

石英石为大多数BC省厨房提供了最佳性价比——耐用性、低维护需求和美学范围的组合。它比花岗岩更能抵抗潮湿、污渍和碎裂。在每平方英尺$55至$120的安装价格（中等至高端价格范围）下，它在转售时保值能力很强。

localizations.titleRu: Стоимость ремонта кухни в Британской Колумбии 2026: Гид от Reno Stars
localizations.contentRu: Reno Stars завершила более 200 проектов ремонта кухонь в_metro Vancouver с 2015 года. 本 гид охватывает фактические затраты на материалы и рабочую силу для проектов ремонта кухонь в Британской Колумбии в 2026 году.
localizations.excerptRu: Фактическая стоимость ремонта кухни в Британской Колумбии на 2026 год с разбивкой по городам и руководством по бюджету.
localizations.metaTitleRu: Стоимость ремонта кухни в BC 2026 | Reno Stars
localizations.metaDescriptionRu: Фактическая стоимость ремонта кухни в Британской Колумбии в 2026 году. Разбивка затрат по городам и советы по бюджету.
localizations.titleTl: Halaga ng Pag-renovate ng Kitchen sa BC 2026: Gabayo ng Reno Stars
localizations.contentTl: Ang Reno Stars ay nakumpleto na ang higit sa 200 proyekto ng pag-renovate ng kusina sa Metro Vancouver simula 2015. Saklaw ng gabay na ito ang aktwal na halaga ng materyales at lakas-paggawa para sa mga proyekto ng pag-renovate ng kusina sa British Columbia noong 2026.
localizations.excerptTl: Aktwal na halaga ng pag-renovate ng kusina sa BC para sa 2026 na may breakdown ng gastos ayon sa lungsod at gabay sa badyet.
localizations.metaTitleTl: Halaga ng Kitchen Renovation BC 2026 | Reno Stars
localizations.metaDescriptionTl: Aktwal na halaga ng pag-renovate ng kusina sa British Columbia noong 2026. Detalye ng gastos ayon sa lungsod at mga tip sa badyet.
localizations.titleVi: Chi Phí Cải Tạo Nhà Bếp Tại BC Năm 2026: Hướng Dẫn Của Reno Stars
localizations.contentVi: Reno Stars đã hoàn thành hơn 200 dự án cải tạo nhà bếp tại Metro Vancouver kể từ năm 2015. Hướng dẫn này bao gồm chi phí vật liệu và nhân công thực tế cho các dự án cải tạo nhà bếp tại British Columbia vào năm 2026.
localizations.excerptVi: Chi phí cải tạo nhà bếp thực tế tại BC cho năm 2026 với chi tiết chi phí theo thành phố và hướng dẫn lập ngân sách.
localizations.metaTitleVi: Chi Phí Cải Tạo Nhà Bếp BC 2026 | Reno Stars
localizations.metaDescriptionVi: Chi phí cải tạo nhà bếp thực tế tại British Columbia năm 2026. Chi tiết chi phí theo thành phố và mẹo ngân sách.

localizations.titleZhHant: BC省廚房裝修費用2026：聚星裝修完整指南
localizations.contentZhHant: 自2015年以來，聚星裝修已在大溫哥華地區完成了超過200個廚房裝修項目。本指南涵蓋2026年不列顛哥倫比亞省廚房裝修的實際材料與人工成本。
